cards.back: Fractions that name the same amount or the same point on a number line.
Decide which is greater, less or equal.
The symbol that means is greater than.
The symbol that means is less than.
The symbol that means the same amount.
Fractions can only be compared when they are parts of the same size whole.
cards.example: 1/2 of a small pizza is not 1/2 of a large pizza

cards.back: Bars of the same length cut into different equal parts.
Cut each third into 2 equal parts: 2 thirds become 4 sixths.
No. Eighths are smaller pieces, so 1/8 < 1/4.

cards.front: Is 1/2 = 2/3 because you add 1 to the top and bottom?
cards.back: No. Adding to the top and bottom does not keep the size the same.
